<!-- release-notes-for: 1.1.5 -->
<!-- One "- **Title**: description" line per change. The in-app updater shows each as a card. Update the marker above to the new versionName in every release PR. -->
- **🧭 New "More" tab**: Transactions, Debts, Zakat and Wallet Settings are now one tap away from the bottom bar on phones.
- **📱 Steadier phone layout**: The screen no longer slides sideways while scrolling, and your first wallet shows first.
- **✅ Clear sync status**: Balances stay visible, and a short "Synced" badge confirms when offline changes are saved.
